set.body:
Journey: Bring in. Acceptance rehearsal.

Outcome
Journey 1 passes with real data.

Acceptance
1. Starting from the XNAT project name and following only tools/xnat2bids/README.md, an operator turns the study chosen in IN1 into an accepted release on the pilot instance (RUN2).
2. Every scan in the study is in the BIDS tree or excluded with a reason in the mapping. Counts of sessions and scans match the XNAT listing.
3. The curator reviews the findings in the browser and accepts. The study page shows the XNAT origin.
4. No XNAT label or accession identifier appears in the accepted release. The label table is with the study's custodian. The DICOM pull directory is deleted, or its retention is agreed and written down.
5. Recorded as a note here: time per stage, number of mapping rules, findings by kind, and every point where the operator got stuck. Each stuck point becomes a note on the owning item or one new mvp item.

Fallback
See IN1: a public DICOM study in a throwaway XNAT container if no real study is cleared by 11 December.
set.title: IN6: Rehearsal: one real XNAT study accepted as BIDS on the pilot instance
